name: Kamishihoro (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Kamishihoro town emblem in green: a ring open at the top and bottom beneath a pair of leaf-like wings.
history: Municipal flag of Kamishihoro, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 May 1968.

features.role: Kamishihoro town emblem — a ring open at the top and bottom beneath a pair of leaf-like wings
